description: Shell script for testing git rebase compatibility between am and interactive backends, including setup, various test cases, and utility functions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file, used to create file contents for testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets environment variables to simulate a fake editor for testing rebase rewording.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks if the editor environment variable remains unchanged.
